definitions.gloss: to fold up, to fold flat, to collapse
definitions.explanation: To fold something into a compact shape by bending it over on itself, or to collapse a structure into a smaller form for storage or transport.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}をきれいに{折|お}り{畳|たた}んだ。
この{自転車|じてんしゃ}は{折|お}り{畳|たた}めるので、{電車|でんしゃ}にも{持|も}ち{込|こ}める。
examples.english: This bicycle can be folded up, so you can take it on the train.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), む-ending.
- Negative: {折|お}り{畳|たた}まない
- Polite: {折|お}り{畳|たた}みます
- Te-form: {折|お}り{畳|たた}んで
- Past: {折|お}り{畳|たた}んだ
- Potential: {折|お}り{畳|たた}める

USAGE:
Often used as a modifier in compound forms: {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{式|しき} (folding type), {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ} (folding umbrella). The potential form {折|お}り{畳|たた}める is very common for describing products that can be folded.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}: folding umbrella
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{式|しき}: folding type, collapsible
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{椅子|いす}: folding chair
- きれいに{折|お}り{畳|たた}む: to fold neatly
